name: nimbata
description: Ask about your Nimbata calls, sources and campaigns in plain language, and set up call tracking from the chat.

interface.longDescription: Nimbata is call tracking and conversation intelligence for marketing agencies and in-house teams. It connects every inbound call to the campaign, source and tracking number behind it. This plugin lets you ask about your calls in plain language and set up your tracking from the chat.
capabilities: Call reports by source, campaign and tracking number
Call search with recordings, transcripts and notes
Tracking sources, tags and custom fields
defaultPrompt: Which sources brought in the most calls last month?
Show me missed calls from first-time callers this week.
What did callers ask about in yesterday's calls?

positive.description: Report call volume by marketing source.
positive.prompt: How many calls did Demo Plumbing get in the last 90 days, and which sources brought them in?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Demo Plumbing project, then reports the total calls in the last 90 days (20 sample calls) and splits them by source and medium: Google paid search brings about half, followed by Google organic, Direct, Facebook and Yelp. The numbers come from the tools, not estimates.

positive.prompt: Show me the missed calls in Demo Plumbing in the last 90 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists only the unanswered calls (4 of the 20 sample calls), each with its date and time in the project's time zone, the fictional 555 caller number or the caller's name when known, and the source. Answered calls are left out.

positive.description: Summarize a call from its transcript.
positive.prompt: Find the most recent Demo Plumbing call that has a transcript and tell me what the caller needed.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the latest call with a transcript, reads it, and summarizes the caller's request in a few sentences (for example a water heater or leak repair job), with the call's date and source. It adds no details that are not in the transcript.

positive.prompt: Explain how calls to Demo Plumbing's tracking numbers are routed.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the project's two tracking numbers (Google Ads and Website) and describes the call flow on each, the "Ring office (recorded)" flow, which records the call and rings the office number. It changes nothing.

positive.prompt: Add a tag called "Follow-up needed" to the Service category in Demo Plumbing.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the tag in the project's Service category and confirms its name and category. ChatGPT may ask for approval first, depending on the user's app permissions. If the tag already exists from an earlier run, it says so and creates no duplicate.

negative.description: Buying a phone number. The plugin has no tool that buys or releases numbers, because that costs money and happens in the Nimbata app. It should say the plugin can't buy numbers and change nothing.
negative.prompt: Buy a new local tracking number with a 559 area code for Demo Plumbing.

negative.description: Sending a text message. The plugin can read text message logs but cannot send texts. It should not try to send anything and should explain that texts are sent from the Nimbata app.
negative.prompt: Send a text to (559) 555-0109 saying we'll call them back tomorrow.

negative.description: Deleting call records. The plugin has no delete actions. It should say the plugin can't delete calls and change nothing.
negative.prompt: Delete all the calls in Demo Plumbing from last month.

review.commerce_description: Nimbata does not sell anything or take payments in chat. Buying numbers and billing stay in the Nimbata app.

publication.release_notes: First release. Read call reports, calls, transcripts and text messages, and manage tracking sources, tags, custom fields, call flows and workflows in your Nimbata projects.
